# Alexander von Humboldt — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was Alexander von Humboldt?", "1769-1859, S. America"),
    ("What is Alexander von Humboldt known for?", "Scientific exploration"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1769-1859, S. America"),

]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
